title: Robert Kaplan: Fed Can Wait Before Hiking Rates

summary: Anthropic PBC has tapped JPMorgan Chase & Co. to lead US sales of shares to individual investors in its potentially record-setting initial public offering, people familiar with the matter said.

title: India Jewelers Hold Off Gold Buying, Betting Prices Will Drop
summary: Indian jewelers are holding back gold purchases ahead of their busiest demand season, betting that a recent drop in prices has further to run, according to the country’s biggest precious metals refiner.

title: SK Hynix Posts Record Profit Amid AI Rush
summary:
SK Hynix posted a stronger-than-expected seven-fold surge in quarterly profit and unveiled an additional shareholder return program for 2026 worth 100 trillion won ($75 billion), underscoring relentless demand for AI hardware. Counterpoint Research Director MS Hwang puts the results in the context of broader industry trends.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China Stock Premium Over Hong Kong Widens on State Intervention

title: Dallas Mavericks CEO on Team Investment and New Stadium
summary: Dallas Mavericks CEO Rick Welts discusses the long-term capital required to build and sustain a professional sports enterprise with Bloomberg’s Randall Williams at Bloomberg Invest Dallas 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Prediction Market Betting Stretches Past Sports
summary: The rapid growth of prediction markets is raising questions about sports wagering, younger traders, market manipulation, and regulation. Sean Patrick Maloney, CEO and President of the Coalition for Prediction Markets, argues federally regulated platforms should be treated as financial markets overseen by a well-funded CFTC, rather than casinos. He joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the industry's safeguards, the controversy surrounding sports contracts, and why he expects prediction markets to expand further into politics and financial markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Montage Intl. CEO: Future Bookings Are Higher Into 2027
summary: Alan Fuerstman, Founder and CEO of Montage International, said luxury travel demand has remained resilient despite higher costs and geopolitical uncertainty. He described the business as coming off a record year and said future bookings are up going into next year, with record holiday-period bookings at resorts across the U.S. and Mexico. He speaks with Scarlet Fu & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Banks Eye $21 Billion Bonds for Broadcom Chip-Financing Deal
summary: Banks are planning to sell as much as about $21 billion of high-grade bonds as soon as early next year as part of a $63 billion funding package that Broadcom Inc. has pulled together to help finance chips for AI developer Anthropic PBC.
